<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern—a prominent M+2 peak at m/z 185 with an intensity about one‑third that of the base peak (consistent with the ~1:3 natural abundance ratio of 37Cl to 35Cl)—the element chlorine can be definitively identified. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic spacing/intensity pattern (e.g., bromine’s ~1:1 M+2, sulfur’s ~4% M+2). Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
